def Transfer (N p m : ℕ) :=
  let C := A.levels.clock
  (A.rep N p m).eval = (C.op m p).push (A.β N p (m+1)) (A.rep N p (m+1)).eval ∧
  |A.β N p (m+1) - A.β N p m - G.slopeConstant*Real.log (A.S.block m).val| ≤
    (C.params (m+1)).drift
ends.conclusion: `Transfer` bounds `|β(m+1) - β(m) - slopeConstant * log(block m)|` by the stage `drift`, i.e. `β_m = β_{m+1} - slope log ℓ_m + e_m` with `|e_m| ≤ drift`.

def lie : Submodule ℝ G.Mat where
  carrier := G.Generates
  add_mem' := G.generates_add
  zero_mem' := by
    intro t
    exact ⟨(1:G.El), by simp⟩
  smul_mem' s _ h t := by

    rw [smul_smul]
    exact h (t*s)

theorem trace_color (c d : G.Color) :
    -(G.colorMat c * G.colorMat d).trace.re = (G.repDim : ℝ) * inner ℝ c d := by
  have hc := G.inner_frob_color c d
  change (G.colorMat c * star (G.colorMat d)).trace.re = _ at hc
  simpa only [G.colorMat_skew d, mul_neg, Matrix.trace_neg, Complex.neg_re] using hc
ends.conclusion: `trace_color` gives `-Re tr(colorMat c * colorMat d) = repDim * ⟪c, d⟫`, so the colour inner product is `-n_G^-1 Re tr(XY)` on `g`.

proof_context.conclusion: `trace_color` gives `-Re tr(colorMat c * colorMat d) = repDim * ⟪c, d⟫`, so the colour inner product is `-n_G^-1 Re tr(XY)` on `g`.

theorem partition_pos (β : ℝ) : 0 < partition G n β := by
  apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg (fun U => (bare_pos β U).le) (bare_integrable β)).mpr
  have hs : Function.support (bare β : Config G n → ℝ) = univ :=
    Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun x ↦ (bare_pos _ x).ne')
  simp [hs]

      ((separation_triangle x y _).trans (add_le_add he hk))).trans (by omega))

mirrorDer d b s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    let t := signedTag H s ∘ q
    let B' := S.mirror H d s B
    let u : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ t
    let f z := S.useAt S z u
    let y := move s.ortho x
    have hy : y ∈ conf _ := move_in _ hx
    let m := Ward.here u y 0 (d+1)
    have em (p : S.Field (d+1)) : m p = S.useAt S y (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,p⟩ t) := by
      rw [show m p = _ from Ward.takes u y 0 (d+1) p, Fin.update_cons_zero]; rfl
    change S.useAt S y _ = _
    rw [← em, map_sum]
    have hf := (((S.class_smooth S hs u) y hy).contDiffAt ((conf_open _).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    calc
      _ = ∑ a, s.ortho.val a b • gradient 0 a f y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _
        rw [map_smul, em, hd.kernels d a B' hy,Complex.real_smul]; rfl
      _ = gradient 0 b (f ∘ move s.ortho) x := (gradient_move _ _ b f x hf).symm
      _ = gradient 0 b (fun z => S.useAt S z (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q)) x := by
        apply GermD
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact signed_front h H B s hz q
      _ = _ := (hd.kernels d b B hx q).symm

  obtain ⟨A,C,hC,H⟩ := capped_tags P h hs hp.toSymmetric hT w j

    filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds (spaced_conf hr hx)] with y hy
    exact (S.at_project T hp.toSymmetric hR hy q).symm
  rw [(he.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]

theorem answer : YM.Bid.D05 := by
  intro G C S f H h hS he n d v
  let w (i : Fin n) : C.book.Token := ⟨d i, v i⟩
  obtain ⟨M,D,B,hB,hf⟩ := image_power h w
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hu⟩ := scales C.S C.path.levels.fits.mesh M n
  refine ⟨4 * D * n,(B * c⁻¹ ^ D) ^ n,by positivity, fun r hr hR x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m,k,hM,hm,hmk,hk,hw⟩ := hu r hr hR
  have hX : x ∈ separated (r/2) n :=
    fun i j hij => lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (hx i j hij)
  have hi : (C.S.a k)⁻¹ ≤ c⁻¹ * (r⁻¹)^4 := calc
    _ ≤ (c*r^4)⁻¹ := inv_le_inv₀ (C.S.a_pos _) (by positivity) |>.2 hw
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_inv, inv_pow]
  change ‖S.read x w‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (B * (C.S.a k)⁻¹ ^ D)^n :=
      separated_bound H hS he w (r/2) _ (by positivity) m k hm hmk hk (hf k hM) x hX
    _ ≤ (B * (c⁻¹ * (r⁻¹)^4)^D)^n := by
      have ha := C.S.a_pos k
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hi _) hB) _
    _ = _ := by simp only [mul_pow, pow_mul]; ring

def InvariantCountertests (F : Final C q S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient n), Comparison F U →
    ∀ (I : Type v) [MeasurableSpace I] (μ : Measure I) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
    ∀ (P : I → Ambient n → Ambient n),
      (∀ z x y, PhysicalWave x → PhysicalWave y →
        inner ℂ (P z x) (P z y) = inner ℂ x y) →
      (∀ z x, P z (U x) = U x) →
    ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      ∃ (Q W : Set E4), IsOpen Q ∧ IsOpen W ∧ closure Q ⊆ ball 0 r ∧
        (∀ x ∈ closure Q, ∀ y ∈ closure W, x-y ∈ spacelike) ∧
        ∃ (f : Test4) (h : TestList n), tsupport f ⊆ Q ∧ HasCompactSupport ⇑f ∧
          (∀ i, tsupport (h i) ⊆ W) ∧ (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) ∧
          (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i) = h i) ∧
          (∫ z, inner ℂ (P z (coherent (-h))) (signal F U f) ∂μ) ≠
            ∫ z, inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (P z (coherent h)) ∂μ

lemma knife_apply (m q:ℕ){h:q ≤ m} (z:S.Field q):
    R.knife m (Q.rise h z) = Q.rise h z - ∑ i:Fin m, Q.rise i.isLt.le (R.cutTest i.val q z):=by
    have hi(k:ℕ):R.liftOne k m (Q.rise h z)=R.liftOne k q z :=by
       exact R.liftOne_affinity .. -- coherence of R.port.ope under inclusions+rot averages (for testing one only, old P.test affinity)
    have hw:R.knife m = LinearMap.id - ∑ i:Fin m, (Q.rise i.isLt.le) ∘ₗ R.cutTest i.val m:=by
          apply Nat.strongRecOn_eq
    rw [hw]
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]; apply congr_arg (_-·); refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_; intro i hv; rw [cutTest,LinearMap.comp_apply,hi]; rfl

lemma knife_mem (m:ℕ) (x:S.Field m) : R.knife m x∈R.stratum m:= by
   induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
   | h m ih =>
      refine (piece_mem R).mpr fun i=> ?_
      rw [show x=Q.rise (d:=m) le_rfl x from (Q.arrival R.continuum.laws.toSymmetric R.lifts _).symm] -- occurrences?
      rw [R.knife_apply, map_sub,map_sum]; simp_rw [R.cut_rise]; apply sub_eq_zero.mpr (?_); symm; rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]; rotate_left
      · intro j _ h
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (show i.val ≠ j.val from (fun he=> h ((Fin.ext he).symm))) with he|he
        · exact (piece_mem R).1 (ih j.val j.isLt (R.liftOne j.val m x)) ⟨i.val,he⟩
        exact R.kills_lower i.val j.val he _
      · exact fun hi=> False.elim (hi (Finset.mem_univ ..))
      have hx:= ih i.val i.isLt (R.liftOne i.val m x)
      let p:=R.cutTest i.val m x
      change R.cutTest i.val i.val p = R.cutTest i.val m x
      rw [test_formula R _ _ le_rfl p, Q.arrival R.continuum.laws.toSymmetric R.lifts p, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _=>?_ , sub_zero]
      erw [(piece_mem R).1 hx j,map_zero]
ends.conclusion: `knife m x` lies in `stratum m`, so the image of Q_j is contained in E_j.
